sentence_stem: If you come to my party on Saturday,
correct_completion: we can play games and eat cake.
full_sentence: If you come to my party on Saturday, we can play games and eat cake.
acceptable_variants: we can dance and talk together.
we will have a fun time.

options.text: I am sorry, but I do not like parties.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the invitation and does not give a possible result of the condition.

options.text: we can play games and eat cake.

options.why_wrong: The past time does not fit the future party described by the 'if' clause.

options.text: the shop is closed on Sundays.
options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to the party, so it does not complete the conditional sentence.

explanation: After 'if' in a first conditional, the main clause describes a likely future result. Learners should check that the completion talks about the future and follows logically from the condition.
